description: Get an inbound webhook's public receive URL, captured sample payload, and the ready-to-paste {{trigger.payload.*}} tokens for mapping payload values into automation steps (speak-upload name/sourceUrl, fieldsMap custom-field values, notify/outbound-webhook templates). Pass either the webhookId or the automationId of an inbound-webhook automation. If no sample has been captured yet, send a test payload to the inboundUrl first (append ?test=1 to capture without running the automation).

automationId.description: Automation id — resolves the bound webhookId and childKey automatically

childKey.description: Override the dot-path used to narrow mappable payload paths (defaults to the automation's trigger.childKey)

webhookId.description: Inbound webhook id (from provision_inbound_webhook or an automation's trigger.webhookId)

name: get_inbound_webhook

data.description: Response payload from the Speak AI API

title: Get Inbound Webhook
